drafted_by: AI, requires clinician review before any real use.

questions.text: What is the main problem that brought you in today, and where in your body are you feeling it?
questions.rationale: Identifying the main complaint and body region lets the system choose the right follow-up question set.

questions.text: When did this start, and has it been getting better, worse, or staying the same?
questions.rationale: Onset and trajectory help distinguish acute from chronic problems.

questions.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how bad is it, and is it affecting your sleep or daily activities?
questions.rationale: Severity and functional impact guide urgency.

questions.text: Have you had any other symptoms along with it, such as fever, weight loss, fatigue, or feeling generally unwell?
questions.rationale: Associated and constitutional symptoms help flag systemic illness.

questions.text: Are you taking any medicines or supplements, and have you started anything new recently?
questions.rationale: Medications are a common cause of new symptoms.

questions.text: What is the main thing you are worried this could be?
questions.rationale: Understanding the patient's concern guides reassurance and follow-up questions.
